understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid through every level and activate all goal cells by stepping onto each one while the carried piece's shape, color, and rotation exactly matched the goal's requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move consumed one stamina, and reaching zero stamina cost a life before resetting stamina. Walls blocked movement, so blocked_directions had to be checked before every action. Shape modifiers cycled shapes 0–5, color modifiers cycled colors orange to blue to green to red and back to orange, and rotation modifiers rotated the piece clockwise through 0°, 90°, 180°, and 270°. A goal only activated when all three attributes matched, and completing all goals advanced the level; losing all lives ended the game.
